normalization: per-modality average-tie entity rank: 1-(rank-1)/(n-1); singleton=1; scores are not probabilities
aggregation: L2-normalized per-photo CLIP embedding -> mean per entity -> L2 normalization; same 4 frozen video frames -> mean -> L2 normalization; cosine; one row per stable entity ID
missing: candidate-specific absent modality contributes 0 without entitywise weight renormalization; globally absent modality reweights remaining modality; pure image never returns text candidates
deduplication: SHA256 unique reference files; entity ID unique candidates; canonical/registered alias unique predictions
model_version_note: provider alias; actual response model/id retained; no stable provider revision exposed

retry.resume: terminal completed/failure records are not retried automatically

input: identical original video bytes sent via video_url for new methods; same input mechanism as historical runs
comparability_limitations: Historical Free/Text C extracted from six-layer outputs; Image/Multimodal C-only prompt by explicit user instruction; prompt confound.
Historical Free/Text used v2 114 entities and old reference state; new Image/Multimodal use consolidated 126 entities and 30 held-in photos; KB confound.
Historical failed raw replies/retry rules may be incomplete/different; report failures without deletion.

evaluation.main_accuracy: at least one asserted entity matches preset main target; extras permitted but false extras counted separately
evaluation.strict_accuracy: main match and no false extra identities
evaluation.normalization: exact canonical/registered aliases only; no keyword or substring credit; whitespace/punctuation normalization only
evaluation.category: label-set exact match and micro P/R/F1; never force mutually exclusive categories
evaluation.empty_prediction: no identity is incorrect for preset-entity task, separate from wrong naming
evaluation.failure: all 30 retained; service/parse failures have empty prediction and one FN; completed-only also secondary
evaluation.auxiliary_fields: parsed entities are experiment-only extraction records, not production Schema fields
evaluation.retrieval_denominator: only gt IDs present in that method KB; image coverage reported separately
